name: stop-an-exercise-the-injury-excludes
why: One of the four hard stops he kept on 28 Nov 2026: an exercise his injuries list excludes. A shoulder is on the list and the overhead barbell press is not in what fits him. He asks for it anyway, playing it down. The coach does not offer it (no card on this turn), says why in a line, and offers the way that is open: the Landmine Press that does fit, or, if the shoulder is genuinely better, telling the app it has recovered.
